description: Na₂Al₂Si₃(HO₃)₄ crystallizes in the orthorhombic Fdd2 space group. Na is bonded to six O atoms to form distorted NaO₆ pentagonal pyramids that share corners with two equivalent AlO₄ tetrahedra, corners with two equivalent SiO₄ tetrahedra, edges with two equivalent NaO₆ pentagonal pyramids,  an edgeedge with one AlO₄ tetrahedra, and  an edgeedge with one SiO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.37-2.68 Å. Al is bonded to four O atoms to form AlO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent NaO₆ pentagonal pyramids, corners with four SiO₄ tetrahedra, and  an edgeedge with one NaO₆ pentagonal pyramid. All Al-O bond lengths are 1.76 Å. There are two inequivalent Si sites. In the first Si site, Si is bonded to four O atoms to form SiO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent AlO₄ tetrahedra and corners with two equivalent SiO₄ tetrahedra. There are two shorter (1.63 Å) and two longer (1.65 Å) Si-O bond lengths. In the second Si site, Si is bonded to four O atoms to form SiO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent NaO₆ pentagonal pyramids,  a cornercorner with one SiO₄ tetrahedra, corners with three equivalent AlO₄ tetrahedra, and  an edgeedge with one NaO₆ pentagonal pyramid. There are three shorter (1.63 Å) and one longer (1.66 Å) Si-O bond length. There are two inequivalent H sites. In the first H site, H is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one O atom. The H-O bond length is 0.99 Å. In the second H site, H is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one O atom. The H-O bond length is 0.98 Å. There are six inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to one Na, one Al, and one Si atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to one Na, one Al, and one Si atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a bent 150 degrees geometry to two Si atoms. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a distorted water-like geometry to two equivalent Na and two H atoms. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na, one Al, and one Si atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a bent 150 degrees geometry to one Al and one Si atom.
